entries.observed_pattern: Base separates current-project authority from reusable process: L1+ work records a receipt, compares alternatives, protects historical material by consumer evidence, validates the exact PR head, and distinguishes contract, automated, runtime, and human evidence.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADAPT the lifecycle, evidence ceiling, receipt, and legacy classification gates while retaining GRIMOIRE's repository paths, Godot 4.7.1 adapter, Circle/Clock/Card product decision, user-approved visual policy, and repository-only Notion retirement.

entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADOPT a single current-entry order and a scoped legacy classification. Preserve user-owned Star save provenance and historical decisions, but prevent them from acting as current build instructions or migration authority.

entries.project_fit_and_difference: REJECT using the stale Base profile as GRIMOIRE product canon. Treat it as reusable-pattern input only and record Circle/Clock/Card as the current project-owned product decision in the project adapter.

entries.observed_pattern: Rulesets can require pull requests and passing status checks, and a strict required-check configuration may require an updated base before merge.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADAPT this as a live GitHub readback rule: inspect the current PR head, merge state, checks, and repository rules before merge; do not infer repository protection from stale local documentation.
